pricing_source: Anthropic first-party API rates (claude-api skill model table, cached 2026-10-06)

fable.notes: Most capable. Thinking always on. Often billed to usage credits, not plan limits. Reserve for ambiguous, long-horizon work where a cheaper model would need retries.

opus.notes: Claude Code default. 2.5x cheaper than Fable per token. Thinking cannot be disabled; effort is the only depth control.

sonnet.notes: Everyday coding and agent work. Half of Opus per token. Good worker model for well-specified changes.

haiku.notes: 40x cheaper than Opus. Prompts over 100K tokens cost more per token ($0.50 / $2.50). Fits read-only exploration and checkable, high-volume work; not long agentic loops.

explore.rationale: Read-only fan-out whose answer is a location or a list, not a judgment. The main session only needs the conclusion.

summarize.rationale: Mechanical transformation of text with a checkable output.

implement.rationale: Well-specified change with tests as the failure signal. Run cheap first; escalate only the failures (re-run-failures policy).

review.rationale: Verification needs edge-case reasoning; the policy requires a verifier at least as capable as the worker and on a different model.

design.rationale: Open-ended reasoning where a wrong plan costs more than the tokens. Stay on Opus at high effort before paying Fable rates.

frontier.rationale: Main-session orchestration of ambiguous, long-horizon work. Fable is never a subagent model under this policy; it is chosen explicitly for the session.

rules.subagent_output_contract: decision / evidence / risks / unknowns / confidence / recommended_action, under 300 words
context_hygiene: Read excerpts, not whole files (CLAUDE.md token economy rule).
Keep system prompt and tool set stable within a session: every change cold-starts the prompt cache.
Do not switch the main-session model mid-task; switch between tasks (caches are per model).
Delegate bulky, self-contained reads to a cheaper subagent that returns one paragraph.
